card.name: Discarding and shedding waste material
card.fires_on: Words in the act of throwing away or shedding something, such as the end of "Discard", "dispose of" and "discarded". It also fires on commas and nouns in lists of material that is shed or removed.

modes.label: Discard instructions
modes.description: The word discard or dispose, or the word right after it, in device-use steps about throwing away caps or needles.

modes.label: Shedding of tissue
modes.description: Words in a list of material the uterus sheds during a period.
modes.example: The blood, tissue<<,>> and unfertilized egg leave the uterus

modes.label: Removing water
modes.description: The thing being removed or drained away, as in tire grooves clearing water.
modes.example: Grooved tires are designed to remove<< water>> from the contact area through the grooves

card.writes: It pushes toward words for leftover or excess material and away from words like leftovers, residuals and excess.
card.plain: It marks text about getting rid of used or extra material, like throwing away a needle cap or shedding uterine lining.
